battle.name: 莫桑比克內戰
battle.brief: 莫桑比克內戰於1977年在莫桑比克爆發，源自獨立後中央政府與反抗武裝之間的權力鬥爭，戰事延續至1992年。英國海軍自1877年起以「Torpedo boat」作為沿岸快速打擊與魚雷攻擊平台，是當時海上兵力中負責高速機動的正式裝備類型。

kit.name: 魚雷艇
kit.history: 魚雷艇在英國皇家海軍體系中屬小型水面作戰平台，負責高速巡邏、魚雷攻擊與沿岸警戒，是海上兵力中兼顧機動與攻擊的正式裝備類型。

countries: 這場通常標記為1977至1992年的莫桑比克內戰，核心交戰者是莫桑比克人民共和國政府、莫桑比克解放陣線（FRELIMO）及其控制的武裝力量，和反政府組織民族抵抗組織（RENAMO）。戰線由首都馬普托、貝拉港與內陸之間的鐵路公路，延伸到索法拉、馬尼卡、泰特、尼亞薩及贊比亞湖北岸山地。1977年時，RENAMO主要從羅得西亞的邊境營地獲得補給；1980年羅得西亞改稱津巴布韋後，南非接手外部支援，並曾派特種部隊越境。蘇聯、古巴與安哥拉人民解放軍支持FRELIMO。1988至1989年的安哥拉南部庫托誇納瓦萊戰役屬於區域戰場，不應誤寫成RENAMO單獨攻占莫桑比克城池。
countriesEn: This conflict is conventionally dated from 1977 to 1992. The principal belligerents were the government of the People's Republic of Mozambique, the Mozambique National Liberation Front (FRELIMO) and the armed forces it controlled, against the anti-government Resistência Nacional Moçambicana (RENAMO). The operating area extended from Maputo, Beira, and the railways and roads linking the coast to the interior into Sofala, Manica, Tete, Niassa, and the mountains north of Lake Malawi. In 1977 RENAMO drew most of its supplies from border camps in Rhodesia, now Zimbabwe. After Rhodesia became Zimbabwe in 1980, South Africa assumed that support role and at times sent special forces across the border. The Soviet Union, Cuba, and Angola's People's Liberation Army supported FRELIMO. The 1988–1989 fighting around Cuito Cuanavale in southern Angola belonged to the same regional theatre, but it should not be misrepresented as a RENAMO operation that captured Mozambican towns.
people: 莫桑比克方面，薩莫拉·馬謝爾自1975年獨立起擔任FRELIMO主席及首任總統，並以總司令身份把鬆散的解放區游擊隊改造成按省區駐防、可以集中指揮的旅級部隊；國防部長若阿基姆·奇薩諾負責早期軍務，1986年馬謝爾在姆布齊尼的空難身亡後接任總統。RENAMO沒有始終如一的單一指揮鏈，烏里亞·西芒戈是早期高層之一，阿方索·德拉卡馬則成為較長期的武裝領導人，外部的羅得西亞情報單位與南非軍官先後掌握訓練、情報及供應節奏。1989年庫托誇納瓦萊前線的古巴部隊由阿爾納多·奧喬亞指揮。雙方各級指揮關係與兵員流動頻繁，公開資料不足以建立可信的年度總兵力表。
peopleEn: On the Mozambican side, Samora Machel served as FRELIMO chairman and the country's first president from independence in 1975. In his capacity as commander in chief he reorganized the dispersed guerrilla forces of the liberated areas into provincial commands and brigade-sized formations capable of concentrated operations. Defence Minister Joaquim Chissano handled much of the early military administration and succeeded Machel after Machel died in the Mbuzini air crash in 1986. RENAMO never possessed a single continuous command structure. Uria Simango was one of its early senior figures, while Afonso Dhlakama became its more durable armed leader. Rhodesian intelligence personnel and South African officers successively controlled much of its training, intelligence, and supply system. The Cuban formation that fought at Cuito Cuanavale in 1989 was commanded by Arnaldo Ochoa. Command relationships and troop movements changed frequently on both sides, and the surviving public record does not support a reliable annual table of total personnel.
kits: 1977年前後可核實的代表性裝備包括FRELIMO使用的AK-47、AKM與SKS步槍，通用7.62×39毫米彈；PKM通用機槍、RPD輕機槍與RPG-2火箭筒，配用40毫米火箭彈；蘇聯82毫米M-37迫擊砲；以及Makarov手槍。後勤車輛可見GAZ-51、GAZ-53、Ural-375D、ZIL-131和Land Rover Series II或Series III，鐵路則負責把貝拉港物資送入中部。RENAMO的羅得西亞與南非供應體系包括FN FAL及G3步槍，發射7.62×51毫米北約彈；Sterling衝鋒槍使用7.92×54毫米彈，Sten Mk II使用9×19毫米彈；Bren與Lee-Enfield使用.303英吋彈；L16式81毫米迫擊砲亦在可用序列內。實際編配會依據時間、戰區及繳獲而改變，不能視為每支部隊固定配置。不同口徑不能互換，是雙方後勤辨識彈藥箱及分配補充彈的主要負擔。
kitsEn: Representative weapons documented around 1977 on the FRELIMO side included AK-47, AKM, and SKS rifles firing 7.62×39 mm; PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPD light machine guns, and RPG-2 launchers using 40 mm rockets; Soviet 82 mm M-37 mortars; and Makarov pistols. Representative logistics vehicles included GAZ-51, GAZ-53, Ural-375D, ZIL-131, and Land Rover Series II or Series III trucks, while the railway moved supplies from the port of Beira into the central provinces. The Rhodesian and South African supply system available to RENAMO included FN FAL and G3 rifles chambered in 7.62×51 mm NATO, Sterling submachine guns using 7.92×54 mm, Sten Mk II submachine guns using 9×19 mm, Bren and Lee-Enfield rifles using .303 British ammunition, and L16 81 mm mortars. Actual allocations changed with time, theatre, and captured material and should not be treated as fixed issue for every unit. The inability to interchange calibres forced both sides to identify ammunition crates and distribute matching resupply separately.
tactics: 1977年的初戰階段，RENAMO以分散小隊從羅得西亞山區越境，襲擊政府孤立據點、軍用車隊與交通設施，破壞鐵軌、橋樑和聯絡線後迅速撤回山區，避免與FRELIMO主力決戰。FRELIMO則以旱季出發的旅級縱隊，從貝拉港經希莫約向馬尼卡推進，並由泰特、索法拉和戈龍戈薩方向搜索殘部；後方依賴鐵路、卡車縱隊與分散儲彈點。這些攻勢在1977至1979年破壞若干武裝小隊，卻因道路有限、 rainy season造成補給中斷、情報不完整及游擊隊分散而未能根除跨境網絡。1980年南非直接介入後，RENAMO獲得較強的突擊、爆破與跨境滲透能力，轉而反覆打擊運輸線和防守薄弱的城鎮。FRELIMO在1980年代中期強化炮兵、工兵、指揮及後勤配合，並在1987至1989年以整編旅發動連續攻勢。庫托誇納瓦萊的區域失利迫使南非收縮其在莫桑比克境內的直接部署，卻未終止秘密援助。1990年後，雙方在持續局部交火中實行停火並進入談判，最終由協議取代主要戰場行動。
tacticsEn: During the opening phase in 1977, RENAMO dispatched small dispersed teams from the mountains of Rhodesia, raided isolated government posts, convoys, and communications facilities, damaged railway track, bridges, and telephone links, and then withdrew into the hills rather than seeking decisive battles with FRELIMO's main forces. FRELIMO responded with brigade columns entering the dry season, advancing from Beira through Chimoio toward Manica, and searching for remaining bands from the Tete, Sofala, and Gorongosa directions. Their rear areas depended on the railway, truck columns, and dispersed ammunition depots. These offensives destroyed some armed groups during 1977–1979, but they did not eliminate the cross-border network because of limited roads, rain-season interruptions, incomplete intelligence, and dispersed guerrilla formations. After South Africa assumed direct involvement in 1980, RENAMO obtained stronger capabilities for raids, sabotage, and cross-border penetration and concentrated on transport lines and poorly defended towns. In the middle of the 1980s FRELIMO improved combined use of artillery, engineers, command, and logistics, then launched successive offensives with reorganized brigades during 1987–1989. The regional reverse at Cuito Cuanavale forced South Africa to reduce its direct deployment inside Mozambique without ending its covert assistance. After 1990 both sides maintained limited fighting while observing ceasefires and entering negotiations, eventually replacing most battlefield operations with an agreement.
data: 關鍵日期可按下列次序核對：1974年9月7日，葡萄牙政府與FRELIMO簽署《盧薩卡協議》，開始安排從莫桑比克撤出；1975年6月25日，莫桑比克宣布獨立；1976年，RENAMO在羅得西亞情報與軍事支援下完成武裝組織，1977年通常被列為全面內戰的起點；1977至1979年，FRELIMO在貝拉至希莫約、馬尼卡及中部山區展開旱季攻勢；1980年4月18日，羅得西亞成為津巴布韋，南非接手對RENAMO的供應；1986年10月19日，馬謝爾身亡，奇薩諾接掌總統府與黨政；1987至1988年，FRELIMO在馬尼卡、索法拉和泰特方向加強攻勢；1989年1月18日至3月23日，安哥拉南部爆發以「草原行動」為代號的戰役，庫托誇納瓦萊前線由古巴、安哥拉與南非軍隊交鋒；1990年10月12日，單方面停火及雙方談判機制啟動；1992年10月12日，羅馬《總體和平協定》簽署；1994年10月27日至29日，多黨選舉舉行。公開戰史對1977年第一次大規模接戰的日期、個別戰鬥傷亡及全戰爭總傷亡並不一致，因此不列未經交叉核實的精確數字。
dataEn: The chronology can be checked against the following sequence: on 7 September 1974, Portugal and FRELIMO signed the Lusaka Accords and began arranging the Portuguese withdrawal; on 25 June 1975, Mozambique declared independence; in 1976, RENAMO completed its armed organization with Rhodesian intelligence and military assistance, and 1977 is conventionally treated as the start of full-scale civil war; from 1977 to 1979, FRELIMO conducted dry-season offensives along the Beira–Chimoio axis, in Manica, and through the central highlands; on 18 April 1980, Rhodesia became Zimbabwe and South Africa assumed responsibility for supplying RENAMO; on 19 October 1986, Machel died and Chissano took over the presidency and party leadership; during 1987–1988, FRELIMO intensified operations in Manica, Sofala, and Tete; from 18 January to 23 March 1989, Cuban, Angolan, and South African forces fought around Cuito Cuanavale in southern Angola under the South African Operation Savannah; on 12 October 1990, a unilateral ceasefire and a bilateral negotiating mechanism began; on 12 October 1992, the General Peace Accords were signed in Rome; and elections were held from 27 to 29 October 1994. Published histories disagree about the date of the first large engagement in 1977, the casualties of particular engagements, and the war's total casualties, so this record gives no unverified exact figures.
cause: 衝突根源並非單一事件，而是獨立後政治整合、邊境戰爭與區域大國介入共同形成。FRELIMO在反殖民戰爭中聯合了不同地區和背景的組織，但取得國家權力後逐步建立一黨化的馬克思列寧主義體制，集中行政、經濟集體化與安全權力的做法引發部分前FRELIMO成員不滿，另有一些人轉入RENAMO。RENAMO則由羅得西亞情報系統直接協助建立，吸納前解放陣線成員及羅得西亞、尚非獨立的南非軍事人員，其政治目標是反對FRELIMO的一黨統治並爭取更大的地方自主。外部支持方把莫桑比克視為南部非洲冷戰的支線：羅得西亞與南非希望削弱對安哥拉人民解放運動及南部非洲解放運動的支援，FRELIMO則由蘇聯、古巴等來源維持武器、顧問及外匯。廣大內陸、有限道路、雨季交通中斷及政府情報與地方聯絡能力不足，使小規模跨境游擊隊得以生存並擴張。
causeEn: The conflict arose from the interaction of post-independence political consolidation, border warfare, and intervention by regional powers rather than from a single event. FRELIMO had united organizations from different regions and backgrounds during the anti-colonial struggle, but after taking state power it gradually consolidated a one-party Marxist-Leninist system. Centralized administration, economic collectivization, and control of the security apparatus alienated some former FRELIMO members, and a number joined RENAMO. RENAMO was directly assisted in its formation by the Rhodesian intelligence system and recruited former liberation movement members together with personnel from Rhodesia and apartheid South Africa. Its political objectives included opposing FRELIMO's one-party rule and obtaining greater local autonomy. External sponsors treated Mozambique as part of the wider southern African Cold War. Rhodesia and South Africa sought to weaken support for Angola's People's Liberation Movement and southern African liberation movements, while FRELIMO obtained weapons, advisers, and foreign exchange from the Soviet Union, Cuba, and other sources. Vast interior areas, limited roads, rain-season transport interruptions, and weak government intelligence and local communications allowed small cross-border guerrilla groups to survive and expand.
impact: 十五年戰爭把莫桑比克由革命運動領導的國家改造成高度軍事化的政府與黨組織。FRELIMO不得不把大量資源投入公路、鐵路、橋樑、燃料庫、無線電網和前線補給，RENAMO則由較小的邊境游擊隊發展成能取得情報、策應突擊及使用多種口徑武器的成熟武裝力量。鐵路與公路反覆受襲、軍用車隊損失及補給節奏惡化，限制了政府調度與經濟運作；蘇聯和古巴援助維持了FRELIMO的軍事能力，也加深政府對外部供應的依賴。戰爭同時改變安哥拉戰區：古巴部隊在庫托誇納瓦萊的推進迫使南非從安哥拉主要戰線收縮，但南非對RENAMO的秘密援助仍延續，區域代理戰爭並未立即終止。各次戰鬥確有重大傷亡，可是雙方採用游擊戰與反游擊戰交替，指揮官死亡、伏擊及追擊造成的損失很難彙總，公開數字也互有矛盾，因此不能可靠給出全戰爭精確傷亡總數。
impactEn: Fifteen years of war turned Mozambique from a state led by a revolutionary movement into a highly militarized government and party apparatus. FRELIMO had to divert substantial resources to roads, railways, bridges, fuel depots, radio networks, and forward logistics, while RENAMO developed from small border guerrillas into a mature force capable of intelligence work, coordinated raids, and operations with mixed calibres. Repeated attacks on railways and roads, losses of military convoys, and deteriorating supply cycles constrained government redeployment and economic activity. Soviet and Cuban assistance maintained FRELIMO's military capacity but also deepened government dependence on external supply. The war simultaneously altered the Angolan theatre: the Cuban advance at Cuito Cuanavale forced South Africa to contract its principal presence in Angola, although covert support to RENAMO continued and the regional proxy war did not immediately end. Individual engagements caused heavy losses, but the alternation of guerrilla and counter-guerrilla operations, deaths of commanders, ambushes, and pursuit actions made totals difficult to assemble. Published figures also contradict one another, so no reliable exact casualty total for the entire war can be given.
result: 主要戰場結果是雙方都未能以軍事手段消滅對方：FRELIMO保住國家、交通幹線與主要行政區，RENAMO則依靠跨境基地和地方游擊網維持政治及軍事存在。1989年區域戰局轉變後，談判逐步取代大規模進攻；1990年10月12日開始的單方面停火及雙邊會談，建立釋放俘虜、停止敵對、縮減武裝及改革選舉制度的程序。1992年10月12日簽署的羅馬《總體和平協定》規定停火、解除武裝、整合武裝人員、承認RENAMO的合法政治地位並安排多黨選舉。協定簽署時RENAMO已在主要戰區失去進攻能力，但解除武裝和後續執行仍不均衡。FRELIMO保住執政地位並依協議開放多黨政治，RENAMO則由武裝組織轉為合法反對黨；1994年10月的全國選舉驗證了和平建立的制度框架。這是一場以談判保住雙方政治存在、而非任何一方取得全勝的內戰，也沒有改變莫桑比克的國際邊界。
resultEn: The principal battlefield outcome was that neither side destroyed the other militarily. FRELIMO retained the state, the main transport corridors, and the principal administrative districts, while RENAMO maintained a political and military presence through border bases and a dispersed guerrilla network. After the regional military balance changed in 1989, negotiations progressively replaced large offensives. The unilateral ceasefire and bilateral talks beginning on 12 October 1990 established procedures for prisoner releases, termination of hostilities, disarmament, and electoral reform. The General Peace Accords signed in Rome on 12 October 1992 provided for a ceasefire, demobilization, integration of armed personnel, legal recognition of RENAMO, and multiparty elections. RENAMO had already lost the ability to mount sustained offensives in the main theatre when the agreement was signed, although demobilization and later implementation remained uneven. FRELIMO retained government power and opened the political system to multiple parties under the agreement, while RENAMO changed from an armed organization into a legal opposition party. The nationwide election of October 1994 demonstrated the institutional framework established by the peace process. The war therefore ended in a negotiated survival of both sides' political organizations rather than a decisive military victory, and it did not alter Mozambique's international borders.
